epic.intent: Exactly two sprints. Sprint 1 converts and independently rewrites the AI Influence design for MNBL/FWG, improves and prepares full generated-world interaction, and implements a temporal knowledge graph, durable verbose history, scoped NPC beliefs, grounded decisions and save-safe actions to reduce long-campaign drift. Recover encrypted strings and obfuscated political paths as evidence; explicitly map feature coverage and intentional changes. Sprint 2 evaluates the design across multiple inference models, including heavier LittleBit-compressed parents, with paired quality/latency/resource measurements and longitudinal graph/drift ablations. No knowledge-graph benefit or heavier-model advantage is presumed. Current work is research and plan revision; implementation and experiments are future epic work.

successCriteria.text: Artifact-pinned AI Influence research identifies observed dialogue/action/diplomacy/API routes, design lessons, obfuscation limits and explicitly separate runtime unknowns; target code is not copied into the product.

Temporal knowledge graph and append-only event history preserve FWG identities, provenance, authoritative facts and scoped NPC beliefs through long verbose campaigns; summaries/indexes are bounded, versioned and rebuildable.

FWG rewrite implements grounded dialogue, multi-NPC intrigue, commitments, political/economic/world actions and initiative; evidence-linked decision receipts and retrieval limit unjustified drift while allowing legitimate character/world evolution.

Typed tools cover negotiated political/economic actions, generated-world travel and quests, and a real supported FWG magic mutation; unauthorized, stale, cross-campaign and duplicate actions cannot corrupt state.

Inference is asynchronous and bounded; cancellation, failures, invalid output and unavailable models leave a playable campaign. Saves restore memory and action state consistently across rollback, cold restart, A/B worlds and two campaigns of one world.

Compare at least three distinct models across two size tiers; genuine LittleBit derivatives of at least two parents include a heavy 30B+ parent, with an explicitly assessed 70B-class lane. Paired held-out immediate/long-horizon trials measure tool effects, graph/decision drift ablations and actual local resource costs. Infeasible required lanes do not silently pass.

The selected LittleBit checkpoint runs locally with Bannerlord on the target machine and passes final dialogue→intrigue→world-action→save/load acceptance. A no-go result leaves the epic unaccepted rather than claiming an unmeasured model winner.

At least 10 simulated years and 100,000 dated events per stress world plus separately labeled live sessions test correction, succession, treaty expiry, mutations, model switching and rollback. Temporal knowledge, commitments and state remain consistent; graph benefit is measured against a bounded-history baseline.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every proposed political adapter has a concrete original call chain, preconditions, effects and pinned API signature; unresolved reflection/encrypted-string targets are named.
No recovered AI Influence source or DLL is shipped in MNBL; research evidence is reproducible and separated from product implementation.

Account for every identified static string decoder use, encoded delegate binding and diplomatic enum case with original-token provenance; separately list runtime/dynamic unknowns, input-flow checks and independent replay results. Reuse the completed static recovery rather than reporting it as new work.

tickets.body:

Reuse evidence/ai-influence/recovery and retained outputs rather than repeating solved discovery. Audit remaining runtime compatibility and dynamic reflection explicitly; preserve original-token provenance.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Map recovered dialogue, political, social, memory, events, quests and autonomy behaviors to concrete implementation tickets and state checks; explicitly list any deferrals.

Define current-world authoritative facts, per-NPC beliefs/knowledge, temporal truth, secrecy, permissions and actionable commitments; state changes can legitimately change decisions without being labeled drift.

Freeze long-campaign history scale, correctness, latency, resource and sustained-play gates before experiments. Require a persistent knowledge graph, replayable event history and traceable decision basis.
Specify public/core APIs and lifecycle/disable/migration behavior; no mandatory Calradia lore or fixed culture mappings, and no placeholder effect counted as a port.

Record a pinned FWGC++ director/communicator/inference/brain inventory as reuse, adapt, reimplement or reference-only with rationale. Assign exactly one authoritative owner per simulation mutation, knowledge projection, NPC clock and dialogue outcome; do not introduce an uncoordinated second world simulation.

Define action-specific player-intent confirmation and bounded delegation policies separately from NPC autonomy and actor capability. Consequential interpreted player commands require exact-term confirmation unless explicitly delegated; ordinary autonomous NPC actions follow their own policy.

tickets.body: Sprint 1 converts the AI Influence design into a production-ready MNBL/FWG rewrite, preserving useful behaviors and deliberately improving world grounding, authority, political consequences and long-campaign memory. Inventory every recovered feature as port/adapt/replace/defer with rationale and test; no implicit parity claims. Implement independently from recovered target code; the downloaded DLL remains a research input. Specify full FWG actions and module boundary, compatibility, feature toggles and ownership. Knowledge graph and event history are primary grounding; model summaries are derived views, never campaign truth.
tickets.title: Define FWG conversion/rewrite, feature coverage and decision authority

acceptanceCriteria.text: Record a runnable LittleBit proof and actual peak memory, or an explicit blocker; ordinary GGUF/GPTQ/AWQ is not a substitute.

Define at least three feasible tool-capable parent candidates using official model cards, licenses and current architecture support. Record exact revisions/chat templates and required training resources.
Pin LittleBit versus opt-in LittleBit-2 settings and preserve tokenizer/tool formatting; no claim that parameter BPW equals whole runtime memory.

tickets.body: Sprint 2 inventories hardware and validates genuine LittleBit training/inference feasibility on the finished design. Initial host observation: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 Laptop GPU, 16,303 MiB VRAM (2026-10-25 nvidia-smi); remeasure RAM/CPU/storage and actual Bannerlord headroom at execution. Pin SamsungLabs/LittleBit revision, architectures, dependencies and real factorized serving path. Separate QAT/training resources from deployment footprint. Test a small checkpoint load/generation first, then measure 30B+ and 70B-class lanes. Do not assume low nominal BPW guarantees fit or speed. Any external compute spending requires explicit authorization.
tickets.title: Establish LittleBit and target-hardware feasibility

acceptanceCriteria.text: Elf/dwarf/tidekin fixtures remain FWG identities despite base-culture art mappings; magic-off and unknown capabilities are explicit.
Live ownership, location, diplomacy and alive state override genesis records; world A/B and same-world separate-campaign queries do not leak.
Context retrieval has deterministic token limits and tests for missing entities, long histories and contradictory/stale facts.

Cross-template tests for fantasy/magic-on and magic-off generated worlds prove no enabled dialogue/event/memory/image path reintroduces fixed Calradia kingdoms, all-human assumptions, blanket fantasy bans or source calendar assumptions.

Specify and test FWGC++ to campaign identity/time conversions and separate native API, packet, brain and save version compatibility. A native binding must test UTF-8, allocator/handle/thread lifetime and error/poison recovery; a managed reimplementation must pass pinned cross-implementation contract fixtures. Incompatible versions reject or migrate explicitly.

tickets.body:
Project verified WorldDataBundle/CompiledWorldDataset and live TaleWorlds state into a versioned fact API feeding the temporal knowledge graph. Preserve civilization/cultureUid independently of presentation culture, plus campaign instance/world content identity. Include generated history, geography, periodic travel, peoples, rulers, active agreements, quests, magic availability and mutation state. Live authoritative events/current state supersede initial source records. Retrieval reads identified facts with freshness/provenance; there is no default Calradia context dump.
Replace every shipped/enabled Calradia-default prompt/template with versioned FWG fact/capability context: default world (06000D95), dialogue, diplomacy, events, memory and any enabled image presentation. The default no-magic/all-human text and high-fantasy image bans are recovered source defaults, not desired product rules. Magic-off worlds still require accurate capability restrictions.
tickets.title: Expose versioned FWG facts and live campaign context

acceptanceCriteria.text: Malformed/unknown tools, foreign IDs, invalid amounts, stale state, replayed requests and injected lore cannot commit side effects.
Multi-step plans revalidate each step and expose partial completion; failed steps do not fabricate success or replay completed effects.
Automated tests verify exact effects and error paths using independent expected state, plus one real game-thread action probe.

Construct bounded request-scoped admissible tool/target menus from actor capabilities, knowledge and current state; retain required legal options through bounded discovery and explicit abstain/clarify. Test magic-off, unavailable diplomacy, absent targets, empty menus and permissions changing during inference; commit revalidation remains mandatory.

Bind confirmation-required approvals to proposal ID, campaign, actor/target, exact terms/cost/consequence and validated state. Expired or changed terms invalidate approval; reject/cancel has no effects; model-generated assent or unrelated ambiguous dialogue cannot authorize the action.

tickets.body: Create schema-versioned query/action contracts and capability registry. Validate entity scope, actor authority, resources, current-state revision, magic rules, bounded arguments and idempotency before game-thread commit. Track proposed, validated, queued, committed, failed and cancelled states; return structured results. Treat dialogue and retrieved lore as data.
tickets.title: Implement typed tool proposals and validated game-thread execution

acceptanceCriteria.text: Protocol tests cover streaming/partial JSON, invalid tool output, refusal, disconnect, overload, cancellation and late replies.
Campaign stays playable when provider is absent; no silent cloud fallback or fake successful dialogue/actions.
One genuine local completion uses the production transport and negotiated tool format; later LittleBit serving can plug into the same contract.

Negotiate and test a provider capability profile: constrained decoding/schema, chat/tool templates, tokenizer prompt-plus-output budgets, stop reasons, cancellation, concurrent context isolation and embedding identity. Unsupported required features fail closed or use a named measured fallback; no silent loss of grammar. Specify local IPC/loopback transport and no remote inference. S1 remains independent of LittleBit compression.

tickets.body:
Implement provider-independent messages/tools and a local endpoint adapter. Bound queues, response length, context, retries and per-NPC budgets. Cancel on scene/campaign unload, timeout and superseding requests; inference never blocks the game thread. Record model/runtime identity and request timings without secrets.
Sprint 1 provider interface and smoke test must not depend on LittleBit evaluation tickets in Sprint 2. Support the independent baseline model for functional checks; genuine compressed runtime benchmarking follows in Sprint 2.
tickets.title: Build asynchronous local inference transport and request lifecycle

acceptanceCriteria.text: Typed nodes/edges and temporal queries recover current and historical ownership, membership, relationships, obligations and world effects from the same journal; migrations and replay are versioned and tested.
Authoritative facts, disputed claims and each NPC's witnessed/hearsay knowledge remain separate with provenance and permissions; secrets do not leak through edges, summaries or retrieval.
Replay is deterministic and idempotent; correction, death, destruction, succession, renaming and expired agreements preserve identity/history without resurrecting stale facts.

History survives A/B worlds, same-world separate campaigns, rollback and cold restart; event retention/archive/compaction preserves references and forensic replay. Bounded working memory does not discard verbose history.

Journal disclosure receipts with speaker, actual audience, delivered text/claim references, time and conversation. Separate retrieval, drafts, approved output, delivery and attributed player speech: unused packet facts, rejected drafts and unseen cancelled suffixes never become told/heard memories. Narration/UI facts do not automatically enter NPC knowledge; preserve historical disclosure separately from corrected truth.

tickets.body: Implement a campaign-scoped typed knowledge graph backed by durable storage and an append-only event journal. Nodes include people, factions, settlements, cultures/peoples, places, agreements, quests, magic effects and events; edges include membership, ownership, kinship, loyalties, obligations, locations, witness/claim and causal links. Preserve world/campaign/entity IDs. Facts carry source event, valid time, recorded time, revision, confidence/status and access scope. Separate authoritative world facts from NPC beliefs/rumours; corrections supersede rather than erase history. Deterministic event handlers update authoritative projections; model output can propose claims or actions but cannot overwrite truth. Choose graph representation/storage from measured needs; a graph database product is not mandatory.
tickets.title: Implement temporal campaign knowledge graph and durable event history

acceptanceCriteria.text: Player can converse with generated characters and follow a query→tool→answer chain grounded in real state.
Rejected or pending actions are represented honestly; cancelling or closing dialogue drops stale replies safely.
Offline/local-provider failure still permits normal campaign interaction and a clear retry path.

Own a pre-display response gate checking structured factual claims, actor knowledge and action/commitment status against scoped facts and current receipts. Unsupported/stale output triggers bounded regeneration or grounded deterministic fallback; unchecked streaming prose cannot announce established facts or success. Persist delivered utterances and validation outcomes without promoting utterance claims to world truth. Explicitly represent intentional lies/rumours as attributed claims with permitted belief effects. Test supported/unsupported treaty, identity, memory, secret and failed-action replies; document semantic guard limits.

Show concrete terms and consequences for confirmation-required player proposals, with confirm/reject/cancel controls and invalidation when terms/state change. Preserve explicitly configured NPC autonomy without prompting the player for every NPC act.

Define visible partial-delivery semantics and journal only what was actually shown/spoken; a fallback records its own delivery, not the rejected draft. Carry speaker/audience receipt IDs to memory; cross-speaker and overhearer knowledge follows actual witness permissions.

tickets.body: Implement conversation entry/exit, character context, visible waiting/cancel/failure states and a player-readable event/commitment history. Display actual action outcomes; support follow-up turns using tool results and current facts. UI must not expose irrelevant implementation details.
tickets.title: Connect grounded dialogue and tool results to player UI

acceptanceCriteria.text: Two playable intrigue scenarios span multiple NPCs and turns, with observable belief/relation and political outcomes.
Expose discovery, betrayal, refusal, interruption and conflicting-loyalty branches; unavailable world features are not invented.
Player and NPCs can dispute false claims; secrets reveal only through explicit knowledge rules.
Test confidential negotiations, exposed betrayal and public scandal: only entitled actors learn secrets; public triggers are deduplicated and unaccepted proposals never become asserted facts.
Claims keep speaker/recipient/evidence/status and consistent cross-channel verification; no suspicion-only action can silently rewrite authoritative identity or wealth.

tickets.body:
Build schemes as persisted multi-step plans with actors, target, evidence/rumour provenance, resources, secrecy, commitments and success/failure states. Initial scenarios include a false accusation challenged by evidence and a negotiated defection or alliance affected by trust. Use validated political tools for material consequences; NPC dialogue alone cannot alter facts.
Keep proposals, accepted commitments and committed engine events distinct. Scope public event creation to disclosed knowledge; confidential dialogue must not become a global diplomatic crisis. Deduplicate one conversation's public diplomatic trigger while retaining its individual facts. Support consistent evidence-based handling of claims in dialogue and letters, with beliefs/suspicion distinguished from proven lies. Do not inherit ruler-only authority when FWG actor capabilities support clan-level intrigue.
tickets.title: Implement political intrigue with beliefs, commitments and consequences

acceptanceCriteria.text: Generated kingdoms/clans can negotiate and perform war/peace, clan transition, fief transfer and a payable agreement in owned test campaigns.
Invalid authority, destroyed factions, stale ownership, insufficient funds and duplicate payments reject safely with auditable outcomes.
Each adapter has source/API evidence, independent state assertions, and current-version in-game proof rather than only mocked calls.
Linked peace/territory/payment packages have explicit consent, validation and ordered commit/recovery; failure midway cannot report an unfulfilled term as successful.
Old unresolved treaties/debts/proposals remain retrievable and enforceable despite more than 15 newer unrelated statements or more than 15 elapsed days.

tickets.body:
Independently implement the observed political seams: relations; war/peace; alliances/trade commitments; clan joining/leaving; fief ownership; gold, tribute and reparations. Use version-pinned public APIs where possible, with explicit actor/ownership/resource validation. Preserve ongoing agreements and partial payment semantics.
Cover the full recovered diplomatic agreement lifecycle: propose/accept/reject/end, terms, expiry, linked peace packages, territory/tribute/reparations, grant/receive fiefs and clan transitions. Graph commitments outlive prompt recency (including >15 campaign days) until fulfilled, revoked or expired by actual terms. Material consequences require validated engine commits; explicit compensation or recoverable partial-state handling is required if APIs cannot commit linked terms atomically.
tickets.title: Implement Bannerlord political and economic action adapters

acceptanceCriteria.text: Tests and in-game probes cover native war/peace proposals, AI proposals, nested actions and re-entry without duplicate consequences.
Feature disabled, provider unavailable, new game, load and teardown retain the declared ownership/fallback behavior.
Patch targets are pinned and missing/changed targets fail visibly without silently disabling all politics.

tickets.body:
Study AI Influence suppression/WithBypass pattern, then design scoped MNBL ownership so native and AI decisions do not double-apply or cancel each other. Verify compatibility with generated campaign behaviors and War Sails. Avoid global suppression before AI is ready; restore expected behavior on disable/failure.
Recovered patch scope includes native war/peace/trade proposals, alliance StartAlliance/EndAlliance/AddAllianceDecision, player KingdomDiplomacyVM proposal enablement, decision OnShowDecision, finance tooltips and tax hooks. Evaluate each enabled native/AI/player path deliberately; absence of a reflected version-specific target must be explicit, with usable player controls and correct fallback.
tickets.title: Resolve AI versus vanilla political simulation ownership

acceptanceCriteria.text: A negotiated quest executes across generated locations and completes only on verified conditions, with reward issued once.
Unreachable land/sea routes, changed target ownership, dead actors and interrupted chains produce explicit replanning/failure.
An in-game route includes relevant periodic/sea behavior when enabled and persists after save/load.

tickets.body: Expose routes and party/settlement targets from the current FWG world. Implement movement/order chains and quests with verifiable objectives, cancellation, deadlines and material rewards. Respect wrap navigation and land/sea capability; avoid arbitrary teleport or invented targets.
tickets.title: Implement generated-world travel, practical orders and grounded quests

acceptanceCriteria.text: An allowed AI-requested magic event changes the real generated world and subsequent AI context observes its committed state.
Magic-off, hidden school, invalid/foreign settlement, invalid strength, unavailable producer and insufficient gameplay authority fail without changes.
In-flight mutation cancellation, failure and duplicate request paths are verified; save/load preserves the actual mutation and its narrative consequence.

tickets.body: Expose an explicit adapter to internal WorldMutations.Report(MagicEvent), retaining visible-school/settlement/strength validation, producer identity, asynchronous work and map-safe-point application. Add gameplay authority/cost/cooldown rules in MNBL. This existing API is a settlement magic event, not a general terrain editor; additional advertised effects require implemented contracts.
tickets.title: Bridge AI fantasy actions into real FWG mutation

acceptanceCriteria.text: A generated-world event changes relevant NPC priorities and triggers a bounded observable plan without forcing every NPC to infer every tick.
Queue overload, event cascades, repeated failures and time acceleration stay within the contract budgets.
Unsupported fantasy effects remain unavailable, while implemented magic/political effects update both world facts and NPC beliefs.

tickets.body: Schedule NPC decisions and event responses using current campaign facts and knowledge propagation. Bound active plans, calls and event cascades; use campaign time for expiry and deterministic rules for which NPCs get attention. NPC actions use the same validated tools as player-mediated conversations.
tickets.title: Schedule NPC initiative and world events within simulation budgets

acceptanceCriteria.text: Cold restart, older-slot rollback and interrupted write restore game state, graph watermark and commitments consistently; future knowledge, duplicate payments and repeat magic are prevented.
A/B worlds and two same-world campaigns have independent graph/cache/index namespaces. Corruption/version mismatch has explicit tested recovery with no silent loss of authoritative records.
Graph rebuild/reindex reproduces facts and decision retrieval at the saved watermark; archive/summary versions and referential integrity remain valid.
Existing pre-AI saves and AI-disabled play are supported through documented migration/disable paths; long-history load/save costs meet frozen budgets.

Persist accepted nondeterministic decisions and validated compaction outcomes as replay inputs. Restore/replay with all inference providers unavailable must reproduce authoritative state and commitments without regenerating historical decisions.

tickets.body: Integrate versioned knowledge graph, event journal, beliefs, decision receipts, action journal, plans, commitments and prompt/tool/schema/config identity with campaign save binding. Save a graph/journal watermark tied to the game snapshot. On rollback restore that exact view and exclude future events from active retrieval; preserve archived history separately for diagnostics. Rebuild projections/indexes from the checkpoint+journal. Never load an unrelated external graph as the current campaign. Cancel inference/mutation during load and revalidate after recovery.
tickets.title: Make memory, plans and world actions save-consistent

acceptanceCriteria.text: Both slices visibly affect generated campaign state and survive a cold save/load; no fixed Calradia targets are required.
Adversarial and failure matrix includes secret leakage, fabricated IDs, stale replies, denied actions, model outage and interrupted mutations.
Evidence names exact builds/worlds and known limitations; unresolved required behavior blocks sprint acceptance.

Exercise ambiguous 'ok', negation, quoted instructions, target/term changes while confirmation is open, cancel/retry and authorized NPC autonomy. Confirm-required player cases produce zero effects without valid approval; positive authorized controls execute once.

tickets.body: Run owned test campaigns covering dialogue→knowledge→intrigue→political consequence and dialogue→quest/travel→magic→world response. Capture input, tool requests/results, state assertions, save identity and package hash. Test failures as well as successes.
tickets.title: Verify full FWG interaction vertical slices

acceptanceCriteria.text: At least 100 held-out scenarios cover all required tool, dialogue, intrigue, magic and failure categories with expected effects and knowledge-access assertions.

Long-history fixtures include at least 10 simulated campaign years and 100,000 dated events per stress world, with separate bounded live campaigns; accelerated fixture replay is not labeled full real-time soak.
Freeze scoring, critical-failure rules, repeated-run protocol, performance/memory budgets and allowed degradation before observing model results.

Score fact/claim retrieval, temporal consistency, secret leakage, forgotten obligations, justified decision change, tool choice/arguments, multistep outcomes and state integrity separately; archive every raw trial/configuration.

Freeze independent blinded, order-randomized multi-visit dialogue judging with candidate identity hidden: sense, engagement/dodging, character/tone, repetition, memory and invention. Archive transcripts, judge prompts, disagreements/adjudication and judge variability. Include valid-but-dodging/repetitive negative controls and grounded engaging positive controls, delayed returns and emotionally consequential outcomes; quality floors are separate from automatic truth/tool scores.

Inventory model roles (intent/tool selection, voice, memory extraction/summary, reaction/initiative and embeddings if used) and freeze separate regression budgets. Shared weight/prompt/template/tuning/compression changes rerun every applicable role suite; voice gains cannot offset unsafe interpretation or memory regressions.

Measure raw and post-gate factual error, fallback frequency and false rejection separately. Compare full versus admissible menus with matched legal task coverage, and disclose runtime capability/decoding differences so adapter or grammar gains are not attributed to compression.
Score unintended player actions, unnecessary confirmation and failures to execute valid approvals separately using ambiguous/negated/quoted input and changing-term controls.

Freeze population strata for common/rare generated peoples, political rank/authority, ordinary/notable actors, persona/stance, magic-on/off and witnesses/outsiders. Define minimum usable dialogue/fallback coverage per supported stratum, sample counts and uncertainty; use matched-event contrasting actors and repeat visits in the same blind protocol without claiming exhaustive combinations.

tickets.body: Evaluate the complete two-sprint design rather than only JSON accuracy. Freeze held-out scenarios and independent state/knowledge oracles after Sprint 1. Include all supported tools, political intrigue, verbose history, knowledge graph retrieval, stale/corrected facts, rights, wrong-world IDs, long-term commitments, model outages and safe recovery. Define drift as unjustified contradiction or loss of required commitments/facts; distinguish legitimate evolution caused by new evidence or state. Separate training/calibration/dev/held-out campaign histories and seeds before QAT/tuning.
tickets.title: Freeze design-level multi-model and long-campaign evaluation contracts

acceptanceCriteria.text: Run at least three distinct feasible models through identical production messages/tools and held-out design tasks, with exact weights/templates/runtime/context/settings and repeat seeds.
Include measured heavy-parent feasibility for 30B+ and a 70B-class candidate; if required heavy lane cannot be evaluated, report the blocker rather than silently replacing it with small models.
Report per-category paired results, decision-drift curves by history horizon, uncertainty and resource constraints; distinguish raw output reliability from constrained-decoding gains.
Choose at least two parents for genuine LittleBit compression, including a heavy parent; maintain uncontaminated held-out data and document exclusions.

Include authored/grounded fallback and task-adapted small-model comparators alongside untuned parents and required heavy LittleBit lanes, using matched packets/histories/settings. Record unavailable comparator artifacts and limitations; these comparators cannot replace required heavy candidates. Pair adaptation and compression controls to separate their contributions.

Report population-stratified and worst-stratum dialogue quality alongside aggregate performance, including supported rare peoples/roles. Score earned personality evolution, actual conversational follow-through and shared events from the correct actor perspective; stronger aggregate scores cannot hide a failed required stratum.

tickets.body: Use current official model cards and architecture support to preregister at least three tool-capable inference candidates spanning at least two parameter-size tiers. Include a heavy-parent lane (at least one 30B+ parent; investigate a 70B-class candidate subject to measured training/inference feasibility). Record dense versus MoE total/active parameters separately. Select for grounded political/world tool performance and long-history stability, not raw parameter count. Compare parents where hardware permits and record any external parent baseline as external, never local. No unauthorized compute spending.
tickets.title: Compare multiple inference models and heavier tool-capable parents

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every reported derivative is a real loadable LittleBit factorized checkpoint; include at least two compressed parents and one heavy 30B+ parent, or explicitly leave required acceptance unpassed.

Paired parent/derivative trials use identical held-out political/tool/history scenarios and matched serving/decoding settings; report belief/fact drift and commitment retention along with immediate tool success.
Measure actual serialized/tensor/runtime/KV sizes and latency, not parameter BPW claims; record every failed or infeasible configuration and training recipe.
Compression selection trades quality, drift, responsiveness and memory using frozen gates; language perplexity alone cannot select the winner.

Rerun applicable held-out role suites for each compressed checkpoint with separate regression budgets. Include ambiguous short replies with/without outstanding offers, valid action controls, summary invention/omission and admissible reactions; report unintended consequential actions and unnecessary confirmations separately from aggregate scores.

Generate calibration/QAT and optional task-tuning records through production serializers/exporters with pinned schemas, templates and source worlds. Publish per-role, action-family, success/refusal/repair, history-horizon, secrecy and rare-obligation coverage with preregistered floors or justified exclusions. Record dropped/rejected exports, audit retained records against source packets/events, and check truncation/label completeness. Keep calibration/tuning separate from held-out histories; legacy FWGC++ voice pairs do not establish political/magic/tool coverage.

tickets.body: Compress at least two chosen tool-capable parents, including a heavy 30B+ parent, with pinned SamsungLabs LittleBit at two or more effective-bit settings each and a less aggressive reference. Investigate the preregistered 70B-class lane with explicit feasibility and actual artifacts if it fits authorized resources. Record QAT/calibration sources, tool/history-preservation training, seeds, training resources, checkpoint hashes and failed recipes. Keep held-out long-campaign scenarios completely excluded. Use LittleBit-2 only as a labeled optional ablation; conventional quantization is only a comparison baseline, not fulfillment.
tickets.title: Produce and evaluate genuine LittleBit model derivatives

acceptanceCriteria.text: The production campaign completes real tool cycles against at least two compressed candidates with no remote inference substitution.
Measure time to first token, end-to-end p50/p95, throughput, peak RAM/VRAM and game-frame impact at the frozen concurrency/context levels.
Cancellation, restart, OOM, timeout and malformed responses are exercised without corrupting the campaign.

Execute identical backend capability conformance fixtures against the S1 local adapter and each actual LittleBit serving adapter: grammar/schema constraints or declared fallback, templates/token budgets/stop reasons, cancellation and concurrent context isolation. Required unsupported capabilities block acceptance.

tickets.body: Serve real compressed checkpoints through the production local adapter. Validate tool templates/parsing, context/KV memory, concurrency and cold/warm latency with Bannerlord running. If generic inference servers do not support factorized layers, implement and verify a dedicated local service rather than claiming support.
tickets.title: Integrate the selected LittleBit runtime with live Bannerlord

acceptanceCriteria.text: Decision includes parent/derivative identifiers, compression recipe, per-category scores, confidence/repeated-run summary, resource measurements and exact reproduction commands.
Selected checkpoint passes the frozen correctness/resource gates and final gameplay/save-load checks; all required failures are resolved.
If no compressed model passes, record no-go and leave final acceptance unpassed; do not claim a successful local model on unrun or synthetic results.

Publish pre/post-gate scores, fallback and false-rejection rates, per-role regressions, blinded dialogue-quality outcomes and exact runtime capability differences alongside paired parent/compression results. Distinguish historical FWGC++ README reports from reproducible archived raw trials.

tickets.body: Compare the complete design across all baseline and LittleBit inference candidates, including heavier compressed models. Publish paired per-category and history-horizon results, ablations and actual local resource measurements. Select the strongest reliable tool/decision model meeting target deployment budgets after LittleBit compression. Rerun dialogue→intrigue→world-action→long-history retrieval→save/load on the selected checkpoint. A no-go result remains unaccepted. Provide a reproducible install and model/config/schema manifest.
tickets.title: Publish paired evaluation results and final model decision

acceptanceCriteria.text: Queries over short and 100k-event histories return required current facts, active commitments and relevant contradictory evidence within frozen latency/token budgets, without widening the NPC's knowledge access.
Late corrections, deaths, ownership changes, expired treaties and save rollback invalidate affected summaries/indexes; retrieval never resurrects superseded facts.
Full verbose history remains inspectable by entity/time/cause; bounded prompt construction does not silently drop long-lived debts, promises, claims or pending quests.
Deterministic retrieval fixtures and an independently authored oracle verify temporal relevance, provenance, access and absence of cross-campaign leakage.

Crowd recent history with unrelated diplomatic statements: the affected NPC still retrieves its active treaty/debt/proposal and relevant older source. Retrieval respects NPC forgetting without deleting the source audit event.

tickets.body:
Build query/retrieval across the temporal knowledge graph, immutable event archive and per-NPC belief scopes. Combine typed graph traversal, entity/time filters and optional text/vector recall; semantic similarity cannot override current authoritative facts. Pin retrieval to the campaign save watermark. Retrieve relevant causal history, active treaties/obligations, relationship changes and contradictory evidence within a token budget, with fact/event IDs returned. Derived summaries are versioned, invalidatable and rebuildable from source; no recursive summary becomes authoritative.
Do not copy the observed diplomatic recency-before-kingdom-filter behavior: active obligations and relevant faction history must be retrieved independently of newest-N or similarity rank. Distinguish archival retention from NPC forgetting/expiry. Invalidate embedding indexes when embedding model, dimensions or retrieval configuration changes.
tickets.title: Implement graph-grounded retrieval and bounded long-history context

acceptanceCriteria.text: Decision receipts identify actor/campaign/model/config, retrieved fact/event versions, proposed tool, accepted/rejected status and actual outcome; discrepancies are inspectable.
Missing/contradictory required evidence triggers additional bounded retrieval or abstention, not invention; a prior model statement cannot overrule engine facts.
Replay identical fixtures and varied-history versions to detect unjustified changes in authority, targets and commitments; justified changes remain possible and traceable.
A model switch, summary rebuild, tool failure or resumed save cannot silently reset commitments/personality or apply stale plans; corrective measures are bounded and observable.

Stable-state repeated inquiries may preserve the same justified position without fabricated novelty; newly verified evidence can produce a justified changed decision. Tests distinguish both from drift.

tickets.body:
Implement a bounded decision pipeline: retrieve authoritative state and permitted beliefs, identify actor objectives and active commitments, propose typed actions with a concise fact-linked justification, recheck state/authority on commit, then store an outcome receipt. Do not request or persist hidden chain-of-thought. Reconcile facts against live engine state and detect unexplained contradictions or forgotten obligations. Allow legitimate changes due to new evidence, personality development, altered alliances and resource constraints; drift controls must not freeze characters or force identical prose.
Remove forced-novelty requirements from political decisions: an unchanged position is valid when evidence/objectives/commitments have not changed. The original demand for new statements and recent-agreement horizon are research findings, not target behavior. Keep active obligations outside recency limits.
tickets.title: Ground AI decisions in evidence and detect long-campaign drift

acceptanceCriteria.text: Publish drift/contradiction, missed commitment, invalid-action and secret-leakage curves versus campaign years/event volume, with multiple seeds/repeats and cause breakdown.
At least 10 simulated years/100k events are tested per stress world plus documented live sessions; synthetic replay and actual gameplay observations are labeled distinctly.
Show whether graph grounding improves required outcomes relative to the preregistered baseline; report regressions/no benefit, retrieval misses and summary errors rather than asserting graph success.
Repeat final longitudinal tests on selected heavy LittleBit checkpoints with exact weights/recipes; critical invalid mutations/leakage fail acceptance even if aggregate scores are strong.
Compare against a faithful recent-tail-plus-RAG baseline with matched information access, context and latency budgets. Report where graph+archive gains or regressions come from.

Test packets with more offers/treaty conditions than delivered replies, rejected drafts replaced by fallback, cancellation after partial display, present overhearers versus absent actors, save/load and compaction between visits. Independently label disclosed facts and assert only those are recalled as told/heard; a genuinely delivered claim is the positive control.

tickets.body:
Run frozen long-horizon replay and bounded live play on all candidate inference models, then repeat on their LittleBit derivatives. Compare the proposed graph+archive grounding with a bounded transcript/summary baseline under matched context and retrieval budgets; ablate graph provenance/current-state reconciliation and memory summarization separately. Inject misinformation, corrected claims, ruler succession, treaty expiry, multiple wars, world mutations, model switches and save rollback. Do not tune on held-out histories.
The baseline must include the recovered AI Influence-style recent tail plus lexical/semantic/hybrid conversation RAG, not just transcript-only or recursive-summary strawmen. MemoryBook in v6.0.2 keeps visual entries and advances processing indexes; it does not recursively replace history with MEMORY summaries. Add recency-crowding and retrieval-configuration-switch scenarios.
tickets.title: Run longitudinal drift and knowledge-graph ablations across models

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of the three action types has actor/target/resource preconditions, a typed executable adapter, persisted policy state, expiry/removal and independently asserted in-game effects.
Clan expulsion handles membership/holdings/war implications; taxes reconcile to observed finance without double charging; quarantine produces declared observable restrictions and ends cleanly.
Unauthorized ruler/clan actions, stale ownership, eliminated polities, disabled disease capability, duplicates and save rollback are tested; UI/context describe actual active policy.
Full 27-case source-to-FWG political coverage matrix maps these handlers and the agreement adapters to implementation evidence; required omissions cannot be silently marked done.

tickets.body: Implement the previously missed dispatcher branches with explicit FWG authority/state models: ExpelClan, SetKingdomTaxPolicy and QuarantineSettlement. Reuse generated kingdom/clan/settlement identity, live ownership and shared graph/action kernel. Define tax scope, collection/finance presentation, policy changes and duration; define quarantine entry/exit conditions, duration and actual implemented disease/travel/economy effects. Do not claim an unsupported epidemiological system or label display text as a completed quarantine. Use recovered handlers as behavioral evidence and independent code.
tickets.title: Port recovered governance actions: clan expulsion, kingdom taxes and quarantine
